opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search by destination, dates and guests
opportunities.description: Search for hotels on kayak.com by typing a destination, picking it from the suggestions, setting check-in and check-out dates, setting rooms and guests, running the search, then optionally sorting or filtering the results.
steps: Open kayak.com and click 'Search for hotels' in the left sidebar (Stays).
Click the destination textbox and type the destination text.
Click the matching suggestion (neighborhood, city, or landmark) in the dropdown.
Click the check-in date and choose the day in the calendar, then click the check-out date and choose its day.
Click the search button.
Open the rooms and guests control, use the increment buttons to set rooms, adults and children, then click 'Update' (or Done).
Optionally set review score, price range, amenity or style filters, and open 'Sorted by' to choose 'Price (low to high)'.
parameters: number of children (and their ages, if any)
optional result sort order and filters

instances.values: Destination 'Le Marais, Paris, France' (typed as 'Le maraise'); check-in 27 Mar, check-out 2 Apr; guests raised to 2 adults; sorted by Price (low to high).
Destination 'Santa Fe, New Mexico, United States'; check-in 16 Jun, check-out 18 Jun; guests raised to 1 room, 2 adults then 3 (in progress).
Destination 'Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi'; check-in 6 Jun, check-out 10 Jun; rooms 2, adults 3, child age 7; then review-score, star-class and amenity filters; sorted by Price (low to high).
Destination 'Los Angeles, California, United States'; check-in 21 May, check-out 23 May; guests 2 adults, 1 room; hotel-class filter set to 5 stars.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search by city and dates
opportunities.description: Use the Qatar Airways 'Book > Hotels' tab to search for a hotel by typing a city, choosing the suggestion, picking check-in and check-out dates, running the search, and sorting the results.
opportunities.site: qatarairways.com (Book > Hotels; Washington search hands off to booking.com)
steps: Click the 'Book' tab in the top navigation.
Click the 'Hotels' link in the Plan your trip menu.
Click the destination searchbox and type the city name.
Click the matching city option in the dropdown.
Click the check-in date in the calendar, then the check-out date.
Click the 'Search' button.
Optionally open 'Sort by' and choose a sort order such as 'Price (lowest first)'.
Optionally adjust rooms and guests, then click 'Done'.

instances.values: Destination 'Las Vegas, Nevada, United States'; check-in 10 Apr 2023, check-out 16 Apr 2023; 2 adults, 1 room; sorted by Price (lowest first).

Destination 'Washington, District of Columbia, United States'; check-in 5 Jun 2023, 1-night stay (check-out 6 Jun); guests changed to 4 adults, 2 rooms; then Booking.com search results, picked 5-star filter and See availability/Reserve on a hotel.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways one-way flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search for a one-way flight on the Qatar Airways 'Book > Flights' form by typing origin and destination airports, choosing a departure date, setting passengers and cabin class, clicking 'Show flights', and selecting a fare.
steps: Click the 'Book' tab and make sure the Flights tab is active.
Click the 'From' field, type the origin city, and select the matching airport in the dropdown.
Click the 'To' field, type the destination city, and select the matching airport.
Open the Trip dropdown and choose 'One way'.
Click the 'Depart' field and click the departure day in the calendar.
Open 'Passengers / Class', use the plus and minus buttons to set adult, child and infant counts, pick Economy or Premium(Business/First), and click 'Confirm'.
Click 'Show flights'.
Click a fare card's price and then 'Select fare'.

instances.values: From Colombo (CMB) to New York (JFK); one way; depart 24 Jun 2023; passengers changed to 2 adults, 1 child, 0 infants, Premium(Business/First); 'Show flights' then selected a Business fare (LKR 1,120,521) and a return fare (LKR 3,125,932).
From Doha (DOH) to Durban (DUR); one way; depart 28 May 2023; passengers 2 adults, then 3 with an infant added; Economy; 'Show flights' then selected an Economy fare (QAR 4,980).
